title: Orunmila update log header, schema version 1
description: The first line of the update log (`updates.jsonl` in Orunmila's home, beside the sessions), where its hash chain starts. Orunmila switches itself to a newer version only while no session is held, so no session's record sees its code change; each switch, and each update it refused, is a record in this hash-chained log, so an update can never look like code that was always there. Update records follow (update.schema.json).
$comment: agent's proposal Q44 (a), approved by O 2026-11-25 (LD299): a log of its own beside the sessions, hash-chained, checked by `orunmila verify`; the brief names no update log, so every field name here is the agent's choice (LD329). Unknown fields are allowed, as in the other v1 drafts (LD17).

record.description: Marks this line as the update log's header, so a reader tells it from an update without guessing.

seq.description: The header is the log's first record; updates follow from seq 1.

created_at.description: Wall-clock time of the first update, which created the log.
created_at.$comment: agent's choice, LD329; the form of the session header's observed_at

prev_hash.description: The hash chain starts from the header, so it has no previous hash.

hash.description: The header's own hash; the first update's prev_hash.
